data.price_sensor_entity: Dynamic price sensor (e.g. Zonneplan electricity tariff)
data.price_attribute: Price to use (incl. or excl. tax)
data.battery_total_capacity_sensor_entity: Battery total capacity sensor (optional, for a realistic 'expensive quarters' count)
data.expensive_quarters_count: Number of most expensive quarters per day treated as 'expensive'
data.solar_actual_sensor_entity: Actual daily PV yield sensor (e.g. SolarEdge)
data.consumption_power_sensor_entity: Household power consumption sensor (e.g. P1 meter)
data.low_solar_threshold_kwh: Low solar forecast threshold (kWh) - fallback only, used until enough learning history exists
data.available_energy_sensor_entity: Available battery energy sensor (kWh) - used to decide whether charging can be postponed
data.manual_charge_power: Charge power during cheap block when solar is low (W, negative)
data.min_soc_percent: Minimum SoC (%) - below this, forced discharge is disabled
data.battery_power_sensor_entity: Battery power sensor (to correct household consumption: positive=discharging, negative=charging)
data.pv_power_sensor_entity: Live PV production power sensor (for even more accurate consumption correction)
data.invert_battery_power_sign: Invert battery power sign (on = negative means discharging)
data.solar_today_forecast_sensor_entity: Solcast PV forecast sensor (today) - for hour-by-hour production estimate
data.solar_remaining_today_sensor_entity: Solcast remaining forecast today sensor (declining, for real-time correction)
data.solar_extended_forecast_sensor_entities: Solcast day+3, day+4, etc. sensors (in order, for multi-day low-solar detection)
data.negative_price_charge_power: Charge power at negative price (W, negative = charging)
data.solar_power_limit_entity: Solar panel power limit slider (e.g. number.solaredge_i1_active_power_limit)
data.battery_round_trip_efficiency_percent: Battery round-trip efficiency (%) - for the PV offset in the reserve calculation
data.vacation_consumption_reduction_percent: Vacation consumption reduction (%) - how much lower than normal during vacation mode
data.living_room_temperature_sensor_entity: Living room temperature sensor (optional, airco expectation)
data.living_room_humidity_sensor_entity: Living room humidity sensor (optional, airco expectation)
data.oven_state_sensor_entity: Oven state sensor (optional, e.g. Home Connect operation_state)
data.kookplaat_state_sensor_entity: Cooktop state sensor (optional, e.g. Home Connect operation_state)
data.steelstofzuiger_switch_entity: Stick vacuum charger switch (optional, charges automatically during the cheapest block)
data.steelstofzuiger_power_sensor_entity: Stick vacuum power sensor (optional, detects when charging is complete)
data.fietsladers_switch_entity: E-bike chargers switch (optional, charges automatically during the cheapest block)
data.fietsladers_power_sensor_entity: E-bike chargers power sensor (optional, detects when batteries are full)
data.appliance_notify_service: Notify service for appliance and battery-mode notifications (empty = HA popup)
data.battery_cooling_outdoor_sensor_entity: Outdoor temperature for battery cooling (optional, empty = reuse existing outdoor temperature)
data.battery_module_cell_voltage_max_sensor_e: Highest cell voltage per battery module (optional, order = module number)
data.battery_module_cell_voltage_min_sensor_e: Lowest cell voltage per battery module (optional, same order)
data.battery_module_temperature_sensor_entiti: Highest cell temperature per battery module (optional, same order)
data.battery_module_soc_sensor_entities: SoC per battery module (optional, same order)
data.battery_module_power_sensor_entities: Power per battery module (optional, same order)
